title: ReferenceReview
description: A reference review: analysis + timecoded findings only. It must NOT mutate canonical skills (mutates_canonical_skills is always false). A review may only PROPOSE a skill change (proposal_only, default true): a proposal is a reviewable patch file under .consistency-frame/proposals/, never a canonical write. Applying a patch needs a separate, explicit authorisation recorded in 'authorization'.

proposal_only.description: True (default) means this review may only propose a skill change as a reviewable patch file; it never applies one. A review never writes canonical skills directly.

apply_skill_patch.description: True only when this review requests that a proposed skill patch be APPLIED to a canonical skill. Applying requires the 'authorization' object (granted_by, scope, branch); without it the request is invalid.

authorization.description: Explicit authorisation to apply a proposed skill patch. Required only when apply_skill_patch is true; the conditional rule is enforced semantically (the restricted schema subset cannot express conditional-required).
